rows.text: The Tongan release of 22 January 2018 says that the King appointed the Cabinet ministers, the first being 'Hon. Semisi Kioa Lafu Sika', People's Representative for Tongatapu 2, as ''Eiki Tokoni Palēmia' (Deputy Prime Minister) and Minister for Infrastructure and Tourism, with effect from 5 January 2018 (printed ''o kamata lau mei he 'aho 5'o Sanuali, 2018').
rows.uncertainty: The stated effective day of the appointment, which gives the holder's from. Item 2 of the same list appoints Lord Ma'afu Minister of Lands only; that is not stated as the end of his deputy premiership and none is inferred. The English rendering is this packet's reading.
